messages:
maria: FYI rolling out microprefix-aggregator v1.0 to canary (eng-runtime). Early numbers look solid — p50 latency down ~28%, p95 down ~12%, cost/token down ~14%.
kevin: Nice! can you drop the bench numbers?
maria: paste below from the nightly harness (chat-short, seq=64):
```
Benchmark: chat-short (seq=64)
Baseline  p50=12.3ms  p95=48.9ms  cost=0.123 units
MPA v1    p50=8.9ms   p95=43.0ms  cost=0.106 units  (-13.8% cost)
```
sasha: Great. Any impact to KV cache hit rates or cold-starts?
maria: Minimal. This change coalesces request prefixes before KV lookup so it actually increases effective prefix hit rate slightly. We observed no cold-start regressions in canary.
maria: Rollout plan: canary 5% (us-west1) -> 25% after 2 hours -> 100% in 24h if no regressions. Gate: p99 tail >5% regression -> immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: canary started for microprefix-aggregator v1.0 (5% capacity) :rocket:
ethan: Ops note — watch tail latency and the "coalescer" dashboard. I put a short dashboard link in #oncall: https://console.redwood/perf/microprefix
ana: Can we get per-tenant cost deltas for the first 24h? Finance wants a quick table to see who benefits most.
maria: Yes, running per-tenant cost diff job now. Will post results to #finance in ~1h.
kevin: Any low-level changes? kernel work or runtime-only?
maria: Runtime-only. Added a "deferred-join" path in the coalescer, tightened seq-aware packing loop, and a tiny prefetch reordering. No kernel patches.
kevin: Can you paste the toggles you flipped?
maria: Config snippet we enabled on canary:
```yaml
enable_microprefix_aggregator: true
deferred_join_threshold: 12
coalesce_window_ms: 6
batch_size_hint: 16
```
sasha: Perf QA ran quick regression tests and gave a thumbs up :thumbsup:
ana: small nit — what's the shorthand? 'mpa' or full name?
maria: either's fine, we'll use 'mpa' in follow-ups.
ethan: If we see >5% p99 regressions, I'll trigger the rollback playbook and assign an incident. Otherwise proceed.
maria: noted. Will post interim results at the 2-hour mark.
perf-bot: regression-check completed — no alerts in the last 30m. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks everyone — big win for latency and unit cost. will update when we hit 25% and then final 100% completion. :party:
